## Main concepts

| Term         | Meaning                                                                      |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Form         | An Excel workbook used to collect data.                                      |
| Form model   | A versioned definition of a form’s sheets, fields, layout and constraints.   |
| Consumer     | A package, tool or application that uses the package’s operations.           |

## Validation

| Term                 | Meaning                                                                           |
| -------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Submission           | The form or worksheet data supplied for validation.                               |
| Validation rule      | A check of structure, field values or a business requirement.                     |
| Validation plan      | An ordered set of rules prepared for a particular form model.                     |
| Validation process   | A YAML file that selects and orders the rule files to execute.                    |
| Validation stage     | A group of structural, field or business checks in the validation process.        |
| Finding              | A reported issue with its severity and location in the submitted form.            |
| Severity             | The level assigned to a finding: error, warning or information.                   |
| Validation result    | The findings and execution status returned after running a validation plan.       |
| Complete result      | A result in which all applicable checks finished successfully.                    |
| Valid result         | A complete result containing no error findings.                                   |
| Validation batch     | A collection of submissions validated with selected plans and references.         |
| Evidence report      | A report grouping findings with the values and locations needed to review them.   |
